title: Admin Activity Inspector: audit log + role insights prototype
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: Admins and security reviewers need a single, browsable surface that correlates role assignments, permission changes, and related API/console activity across workspaces. Current audit flow is fragmented: separate timeline view for logs and another screen for role definitions, making access reviews slow and error-prone.

Goal: Design an "Admin Activity Inspector" panel that combines a searchable audit timeline with contextual role and workspace snapshots, linked evidence (PRs, invitations, session revocations), and lightweight actions for common remediation (revoke session, remove role, export for compliance). The prototype should explore progressive disclosure for complex policies and support both org-level and workspace-level perspectives.

Scope: Console UX only (no backend changes). Includes high-fidelity panel prototypes, edge-case flows for cross-workspace role binds, mobile/responsive variants for smaller admin screens, and a review-ready spec for handoff to ENG and PM. Not in scope: RBAC enforcement logic and KMS integrations.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates combined timeline + role snapshot for a selected actor
Search and filter interactions (by user, action, date range, resource) are wireframed and clickable
Design provides clear remediation affordances (revoke session, remove role, start access review) and explains required backend hooks in handoff notes
Accessibility annotations included: keyboard navigation for timeline, screenreader labels for role badges
comments: 2026-02-22 — Aisha: Initial discovery workshop notes added to Confluence. Key constraint: we must not surface full log payloads in UI by default for PII reasons.

2026-02-27 — Mateo: First wireframes uploaded to Figma. Two competing approaches: (A) timeline-first with sidecar role snapshot, (B) role-first with embedded timeline—team prefers (A) for faster incident triage.
2026-03-02 — Lena (PM): Confirmed acceptance criteria and asked to include an export CSV option for quarterly audits.
2026-03-05 — Ravi (Security): Flagged requirement: any 'revoke session' action needs an audit entry and privileged operation review. Marked security_review_required=true.
2026-03-08 — Mateo: High-fidelity prototype ready. Usability test with 4 internal admins scheduled for 2026-03-11.

2026-03-10 — Usability test summary: admins liked inline role snapshots but requested clearer staging of bulk remediation actions; added 'confirm and schedule' step in flows. Moving to In Review for design critique meeting on 2026-03-12.
decisions: Choose timeline-first layout (favors incident response) over role-first for initial release
Progressive disclosure: show high-level permission groups on cards; expand to full policy JSON only on demand
Provide only surface-level log details by default; full payload available via 'download evidence' to satisfy PII constraints
